nodes.title: Face ID Prompt

widgets_values:
You will receive:

1. A reference image of a person.
2. An original `ref_t2v` video caption.

Your task is to analyze the reference image and add the person’s visible facial, body, clothing, and accessory details to the original caption with minimal edits.

REFERENCE IMAGE:
[REFERENCE IMAGE PROVIDED TO THE MODEL]

ORIGINAL VIDEO CAPTION:

Transform person in first image into a character sheet view with all poses from the second image. Follow poses exactly. Arranged left to right: a close-up of the face, then full-body front, side, and backviews, on a white background. The person must look exactly same in every pose. 

Maintain identity, ID and facial characteristic of first image. Keep the consistency of face from first image.  High quality highly detailed character sheet.

Describe the key features of the input image (color, shape, size, texture, objects, background), then explain how the user's text instruction should alter or modify the image. Generate a new image that meets the user's requirements while maintaining consistency with the original input where appropriate.

ref_t2v:  A gorgeous female explorer  is walking high up in tall norwegian mountains with a stunning scenery in the background. Tracking camera as she walks in a small path in the terrterrain.

She stops and takes a break. Camera pulls in toward her face.
She talks and she says: "So now its your turn, go try out the new Face ID lora, and  make your character explore new worlds". 

The camera pulls out, to a majestic panoramic view of the stunning norwegian mountain landscape
